method_boundary.purpose: Bind the production methodology to attributable public sources and keep engineering references separate from method authority.
prohibited_promotions: A GitHub star count cannot promote a repository to method authority.
A secondary transcript cannot be labeled an official verbatim transcript.
A fixed threshold, weighted score or trading signal in an open-source repository cannot be attributed to Buffett or Munger without a primary source.
No third-party code or copyrighted long-form text was copied into the Seed methodology.

method_claims.statement: Treat a share as a fractional ownership interest in a business and judge long-term business progress rather than short-term quotation changes.
Optimize per-share intrinsic business value; intrinsic value is an estimate of discounted owner cash, not a precise reported number.
Research understandable businesses with favorable long-term prospects, capable and trustworthy management, and a sensible price.
Separate genuine return improvement from growth created by a larger capital base; EPS growth alone is insufficient.
Bridge reported earnings to owner earnings by considering attributable non-cash charges, maintenance capex and required working capital, and retain uncertainty as a range.
Prefer a durable, high-quality business at a sensible price to a statistically cheap mediocre business whose economics consume value.
Test empire building, peer imitation, inertia and other incentives that can make management allocate capital against per-share value.
The boundary and evidence quality of the circle of competence matter more than its size; outside-circle is a valid terminal state.
A long holding horizon requires a defensible view of future business economics, not confidence in short-term price forecasts.
A moat is a mechanism and a direction of change; test whether it is widening or narrowing and preserve disconfirming evidence.
Distinguish businesses that can reinvest at attractive returns from capital-intensive businesses that consume cash merely to remain competitive.
High returns require a durable competitive mechanism; a famous manager or a high margin is not by itself a moat.
Avoid financing structures that can force permanent loss or dependence on external capital, even if leverage could improve average returns.
Industry growth does not prove that a specific company will retain profits or attractive capital returns.
Separate business-value research from short-term market forecasting; price is an input to value comparison, not evidence of business quality.
Evaluate repurchases through price, intrinsic value, share-count change and opportunity cost for continuing owners.
Evaluate management through candid owner communication and the per-share results of reinvestment, acquisition, debt, distribution, repurchase and issuance decisions.
Preserve uncertainty, continue learning, wait for evidence and avoid leverage that removes the ability to wait.
Buffett's own account credits Munger with moving Berkshire away from merely cheap cigar-butt businesses toward wonderful businesses purchased at fair prices.
Use multiple disciplines and explicit checklists to understand causal business systems and expose missing models.
Use incentive and cognitive-bias checks as red-team questions, supported by company facts rather than psychological labels.
Separate issued, treasury, non-treasury, regulatory public float, observable tradable-float proxy and active supply; model unlock and newly listed shares by listing line and trading-capacity impact.

adopt_patterns: Progressive disclosure between SKILL.md, references and scripts
reject_patterns: No finance or Buffett-Munger method authority is implied by the skill format

adopt_patterns: Separation of data retrieval from analysis
reject_patterns: The repository is infrastructure, not Buffett-Munger method authority
Module and data licenses require separate review before reuse
Warren agent hard-codes thresholds such as ROE above 15 percent and debt-to-equity below 0.5
Munger agent combines moat, management, predictability and valuation with fixed weights
Bullish, bearish and neutral signals are not production research states
Margin and ROIC thresholds are not attributable Buffett-Munger rules

adopt_patterns: Parallel evidence gathering and explicit bear case
reject_patterns: Uniform star ratings and hard thresholds across industries
ROE, gross-margin, leverage and safety-margin cutoffs presented as checklist standards
Buy, add-position or decision language
Attributions to investor masters that do not resolve to primary sources

adopt_patterns: DCF, relative valuation and SOTP applicability routing
Bull, base and bear scenario presentation
reject_patterns: yfinance and live quote fields cannot substitute for statutory filing facts
US-centric default rates and method weights cannot be silently applied to A/H companies
A blended implied price is not a Buffett-Munger decision
Technical and tactical trading signals cannot alter value-quality gates
A trading-oriented host workflow is not long-term method authority
Composite stock evaluation that mixes technicals, sentiment or macro into value quality
Buy or sell signals
US-only source assumptions for A/H work

adopt_patterns: Separate management, guidance, competition and capital-allocation lenses
reject_patterns: External MCP output is not a statutory primary source by default
Metric ratings cannot replace company-level evidence reconciliation

adopt_patterns: Atomic topic indexing across shareholder letters
Small reusable questions for circle, moat and capital allocation
reject_patterns: Year or chapter references must resolve back to the official letter
Author interpretations and thresholds are not primary authority

adopt_patterns: Bias checklist as a red-team prompt
reject_patterns: A repository summary of a copyrighted book is not an original public speech
No long-form book text or secondary paraphrase can become source-layer company facts
